inputs.text: [excited] He was 13 meters long — as long as a school bus! Standing up, he was 4 meters tall — as tall as a double-decker bus! [amazed] And he weighed 8,000 kilos — as heavy as 4 rhinos! [serious] And yet, scientists think he could only run about 12 miles an hour — as fast as Dad running. Not faster.
[curious] Not faster than a car, like in the movies?
[confident] No, [gently] his legs were too heavy for that. But 12 miles an hour was plenty fast enough for him.
